hello all

the question about tapping a tapped vampire puzzles my, LSJ says that
you can tap a tapped vampire without effect to play brujah debates ...
if is this correct can i play defection with a tapped vampire??, what
other cards can a tapped vampire play?? i thought that it can't play
cards other that reaction cards to untap ... what kind of reactions or
other kind of cards can play a tapped vampire??, or can play cards at
all??

bye!!!

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 11 Jan 2001 20:47:18 GMT, 1gan...@teleline.es (Geb) wrote:

>hello all
>
>the question about tapping a tapped vampire puzzles my, LSJ says that
>you can tap a tapped vampire without effect to play brujah debates ...

You don't "tap" a vampire to play Brujah Debate; you play Brujah
Debate as a Master card, and its only requirement is that you control
a Brujah and spend one pool.

While it is in play, during your Master phase you tap (one of) your
highest capacity Brujah. If you have multiple Brujah Debates in play,
you may tap an already-tapped vampire who meets the rest of the BD
requirements.

>if is this correct can i play defection with a tapped vampire??, what

No, because tapped vampires may not play ANY reaction cards. This is
a totally different situation than BD, because it is dealing with a
reaction card played by a vampire, not a Master card played by a
Methuselah.

>other cards can a tapped vampire play?? i thought that it can't play
>cards other that reaction cards to untap ... what kind of reactions or
>other kind of cards can play a tapped vampire??, or can play cards at
>all??

The only reaction cards a tapped vampire may play are ones that say
"playable by a tapped vampire" or "usable by a tapped vampire",
overriding the general rule that tapped vampires may not play reaction
cards. This includes Wake, Forced Awakening, Guard Dogs, Rat's
Warning, 2nd Tradition, and probably a couple others that I've
forgotten; but they will ALL have the card text.

No. only untapped vampires can play reaction cards. [1.6.3.5]

> other cards can a tapped vampire play?? i thought that it can't play

Combat cards, mostly. Also cards like Wakey and Cats' Guidance that
say they can be played by a tapped vampire.
